research.name: SmoothUI
research.note: Animated React components for shadcn/ui, including a conic-gradient Siri orb, WebGL shader transitions and a Time Machine panel stack.

effects: Siri-style orb built from layered conic gradients that reacts to AI state and microphone amplitude
WebGL SDF blob transition that swaps content under soft-merged circles with noisy edges
macOS Time Machine style stack of panels receding in 3D perspective
Dynamic Island style expanding notification pill with spring motion
